label: Dupilumab (Dupixent) — eosinophilic esophagitis · Nguyen 2026 · 2-compartment SC · linear + Michaelis-Menten
_note: Third dupilumab model: eosinophilic esophagitis, ages 1 and up, pooled with healthy volunteers. The healthy-volunteer structure is fixed; EoE patients differ through three multipliers.

_source.document: Nguyen et al. 2026, Clin Pharmacol Ther (doi:10.1002/cpt.70233, PMC13156347)
_source.table: Table 2 (parameters), Data S1 (NONMEM code, used to settle table typos), Table S3 (population), Tables S6 and 3 (simulated exposures), Discussion (typical EoE CL and Vss)
_source.subjects: 632 subjects: 202 healthy volunteers (IV and SC single doses) and 430 EoE patients (98 aged 1-<12, 97 aged 12-<18, 235 adults); 4459 samples

limitations: The 3-stage transit delay before absorption (MTT 0.0726 day ≈ 1.7 hours) is omitted and only first-order absorption is used. It is short relative to the absorption rate (ka 0.284/day), so the impact is small.
The volume-of-distribution coefficient for EoE patients uses the model-code value (1.298), not the paper's table value (1.26); it is the one that reproduces the Vss of 5.01 L in the text.
The weight exponent on volume of distribution uses the table value 0.710 (the code has 0.704).
The original analysis varied weight over time for patients under 18 years (growth), but this app holds weight fixed.
The validation values (Table S6) are medians from simulating the whole weight band, so they are compared against a single patient at a representative weight (band midpoint or mean weight).
Only the mean and SD of patient weight are available, so the log-normal median was back-calculated.
